visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An older man dressed in a traditional black jacket and black skullcap stands on a rooftop with trees in the background. He executes a high vertical leap and lands perfectly with both feet inside a small blue plastic basin placed on a wooden stool, then holds a pose with his arms outstretched. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor living room with beige curtains. A young boy in a grey graphic t-shirt stands on a pink mat, looking sideways with a serious expression as he prepares to mimic the action. (3) A close-up shot captures a pair of small feet landing in a black bowl decorated with red cloud patterns, causing a significant splash of water onto the wooden surface below. (4) Hands are shown pouring a yellowish-brown liquid from a clear plastic pitcher into a glass mug, while a beer emoji appears as an overlay. (5) A human foot and a hand are positioned over the pitcher as they perform a rock-paper-scissors game using gestures; emoji symbols for a fist and a peace sign appear on the screen to represent the moves. (6) The boy is seen again on the pink mat, now looking at the camera with a satisfied smile and giving a thumbs-up gesture. (7) The video concludes with a close-up of the boy laughing hysterically, his mouth wide open in a expression of pure joy.
